purpose: Represent external authenticated-source access failure without misclassifying it as a scientific null or statistical non-estimability result.

allowed_only_when: the frozen Aikens environmental reconstruction requires authenticated source access
a fresh credential-only preflight records configured=false
no alternative environmental product, time interval, matching tolerance, or unregistered source is substituted

distinction_from_not_estimable.ACCESS_BLOCKED: execution did not occur because required authenticated source access was unavailable
distinction_from_not_estimable.NOT_ESTIMABLE: execution occurred far enough to evaluate the frozen reconstruction/support criteria, but the registered contrast could not be estimated

package_behavior.final_science_blocker: author decision required: submit with ACCESS_BLOCKED state or wait for authenticated execution

claim_boundary: ACCESS_BLOCKED is not evidence for or against the registered lambda prediction
ACCESS_BLOCKED must not be described as a null result
ACCESS_BLOCKED must not be converted to NOT_ESTIMABLE
future authenticated execution remains permissible under the original frozen contract
